name: calm-but-ready-explainer
description: Remotion implementation of the 'Calm, But Ready' animated explainer

scripts.studio: npm run audio:ensure && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run audio:ensure && remotion render src/index.ts CalmButReady out/calm-but-ready.mp4
scripts.render:preview: npm run audio:ensure && remotion render src/index.ts CalmButReady out/calm-but-ready-540p.mp4 --scale=0.5
